name: Gin'iro no Ki ~Konayuki no Photograph~
original_name: 銀色の樹 ～粉雪のフォトグラフ～
source:
After a drinking party, our guy lost his virginity to an older girl in his photo club and became afraid of girls. Now it's 4 weeks till Christmas, can you help him cure his fear and get one of the 4 girls?

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
